The on-disk test file at lines 870-886 has the unmodified `test_matching_branch_cannot_override_different_linked_pr` body (no source-pull-request line added to issue body, no stale cache creation) and does not contain `test_issue_origin_can_use_matching_branch_with_different_linked_pr` or `test_issue_origin_cannot_use_matching_pr_token_without_branch`. The autofix commit 8e7465f8 (LAST COMMIT STAT) claims 53 insertions and 15 deletions across 5 files; the on-disk code reflects only a single comment change (test_a_later_stage_reuses_completed_runs at line 658: comment change from "non-timeline run still needs one metadata GET" to "Both run identities are in the head-SHA timeline"). The remaining 42 new/deleted lines in the source file and ~36 new lines in the test file from the LAST RUN DIFF are absent from disk.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:862 and :879 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The on-disk `_verify_run` derives `pr_number` from `source_number` and unconditionally rejects runs linked to a different PR, so legitimate source-issue runs with a different implementation PR are skipped.
  WHY: The intended `source_kind` carve-out is absent; a source issue such as #6133 with implementation PR #7777 returns `run_pr_mismatch`.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:549-559 and :567-582 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_occurrence_context` and `heal_context` do not capture or propagate `source_kind`.
  WHY: The downstream `_verify_run` guard and `body_ctx` extension cannot distinguish issue-origin refs.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:609 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `trusted_run_refs` `body_ctx` projection omits `source_kind`.
  WHY: The intended carve-out cannot fire, and body-sourced runs are treated as source-PR runs.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Verify every run against server-fetched source-issue or PR identity, head SHA, and workflow metadata before fetching evidence; skip runs that cannot be bound to the reported failure." Specifically: the LAST RUN DIFF introduces a `source_kind` field so that an issue-origin run with a different linked PR is accepted when its branch matches the failure, while a source-PR run with a different linked PR is rejected even when the branch matches.
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:549-559, :567-582, :609, :862, :879-892; tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:868-887 (modified test) and the two new tests `test_issue_origin_can_use_matching_branch_with_different_linked_pr` and `test_issue_origin_cannot_use_matching_pr_token_without_branch`; README.md:1409-1411; agents.md:218-222; changelog.d/6334-heal-evidence-same-repo-run-binding.md:2.
  Evidence of absence: On-disk scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:550 still uses the non-capturing `(?:pull request|issue)` and returns no `source_kind`; :569-582 has no `source_kind` field; :609 builds body_ctx from the five pre-LAST-RUN keys; :862 is `if not sha or not workflow_name or (not branch and pr_number is None):`; :879 has no `ref.get("source_kind") != "issue"` guard; the workflow-name branch at :883 has no issue-origin exception. On-disk tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:870-886 still uses `_issue()` unmodified (no `- **Source pull request:** ...` body line) and the `cached` branch still calls `_collector(...).collect(_issue(), [], issue_repo=REPO)` instead of creating a stale evidence directory. Neither `test_issue_origin_can_use_matching_branch_with_different_linked_pr` nor `test_issue_origin_cannot_use_matching_pr_token_without_branch` exists in the file. On-disk README.md:1409-1411, agents.md:218-222, and changelog.d/6334-heal-evidence-same-repo-run-binding.md:2 still carry the pre-LAST-RUN prose. The only on-disk artefact from the LAST RUN DIFF is the one-line comment at tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:658 ("# Both run identities are in the head-SHA timeline."). The LAST COMMIT 8e7465f8 claims 53 insertions across the five files, but the working tree only reflects that one comment change, so the security-fix intent is not delivered on the on-disk code path.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The issue's recommendation also requires server-side validation that the run is associated with the reported source issue or PR before evidence is fetched, so a same-repo run URL with matching branch / head SHA / workflow name cannot be used to collect evidence from an unrelated run.
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py, `Collector._verify_run` source-issue identity verification.
  Evidence of absence: The LAST RUN DIFF's intended source-issue path binds a run to the failure only by matching `head_branch` + `head_sha` + `workflow_name` and allowing a `[pr:<n>]` suffix in the run name; it does not call the GitHub API to confirm the run is associated with the specific source issue (e.g. that the issue's closing pull request is the run's linked PR, or that the run's branch is the issue's implementation branch). The on-disk code has the same gap. An attacker who can author an intake-allowed run URL in a heal issue body (or any path that can inject a same-repo run URL the collector will trust) can therefore collect evidence from a run that has nothing to do with the reported failure, so long as its head SHA, branch, and workflow name match.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
